method: One GET per DISTINCT HOST listed in either public x402 Bazaar (Coinbase CDP, PayAI), using the first resource that index advertises for that host. Conformant = HTTP 402 AND a PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header AND x402Version 2 in the body AND an extensions.bazaar block. Identifiable UA, 12s timeout, 24 concurrent. Nothing signed, nothing paid, no door settled.
verification: Sampled 12 hosts from each of status=None, 404 and 405 and re-probed with a browser User-Agent and a 30s timeout: all 36 reproduced their original outcome exactly. The result is not an artefact of the probe's UA or timeout.
self_check: councilof.ai appears in this census and is conformant (402, header, v2, extension). It is measured by the same probe as everyone else, not exempted.
not_a_measurement_of: a seller's honesty, product quality, price, or whether a door would deliver after payment. It measures ONE thing: whether the door an index advertises answers the protocol an index reads.
